+async def test_chat_and_responses_use_configured_base_url(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    api_base: str | None,
+    env_base: str | None,
+    base_url: str | None,
+    expected_root: str,
+) -> None:
+    from any_llm.providers.groq.groq import GroqProvider
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("GROQ_BASE_URL", raising=False)
+    if env_base is not None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("GROQ_BASE_URL", env_base)
+
+    requests: list[httpx.Request] = []
+
+    def handle(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
+        requests.append(request)
+        if request.url.path.endswith("/responses"):
+            return httpx.Response(200, json=_make_openai_response("hi").model_dump(mode="json"))
+        return httpx.Response(
+            200,
+            json={
+                "id": "chat-1",
+                "object": "chat.completion",
+                "created": 0,
+                "model": "test-model",
+                "choices": [{"index": 0, "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "hi"}, "finish_reason": "stop"}],
+            },
+        )
+
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle)) as http_client:
+        provider = GroqProvider(api_key="test-api-key", api_base=api_base, http_client=http_client, base_url=base_url)
+        await provider.acompletion("test-model", [{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}])
+        await provider.aresponses("test-model", "hello")
+
+    assert [str(request.url) for request in requests] == [
+        f"{expected_root}/openai/v1/chat/completions",
+        f"{expected_root}/openai/v1/responses",
+    ]
+    assert all(request.headers["authorization"] == "Bearer test-api-key" for request in requests)
